verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only Orb's essential dunning, which retries failed charges after 1, 4, and 9 days. That is an adjacent recovery control, not self-updating cards. Nothing in the pack covers network account updater support, backup or fallback payment methods, or hosted update-payment-method pages.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages
